queries.name: indexes
queries.sql: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND tbl_name IN ('event_log','observations','chat_messages','session_navigation')

rows.name: idx_event_log_session_stream
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_event_log_session_stream
			ON event_log(session_id, stream_id)

rows.name: idx_event_log_room_stream
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_event_log_room_stream
			ON event_log(room_id, stream_id)

rows.name: idx_event_log_topic_stream
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_event_log_topic_stream
			ON event_log(topic, stream_id)

rows.name: idx_event_log_idempotency
rows.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_event_log_idempotency
			ON event_log(idempotency_key)
			WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL

rows.name: idx_chat_messages_session_sequence
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_messages_session_sequence
			ON chat_messages(session_id, sequence)

rows.name: idx_observations_session_sequence
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_observations_session_sequence
			ON observations(session_id, sequence)

rows.name: idx_session_navigation_room_sort
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_session_navigation_room_sort
			ON session_navigation(room_id, archived_at, sort_key DESC)

rows.name: idx_session_navigation_root
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_session_navigation_root
			ON session_navigation(root_session_id, parent_id)

rows.name: idx_event_log_session_sequence_stream
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_event_log_session_sequence_stream
			ON event_log(session_id, session_sequence DESC, stream_id DESC)

rows.name: idx_event_log_session_type_sequence_stream
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_event_log_session_type_sequence_stream
			ON event_log(session_id, type, session_sequence ASC, stream_id ASC)

rows.name: idx_event_log_unread_session_stream
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_event_log_unread_session_stream
			ON event_log(session_id, stream_id)
			WHERE (retention_class = 'chat_message' AND type IN ('user.message.accepted', 'assistant_message'))
				OR type = 'session_error'

rows.name: idx_event_log_session_tool_event_sequence_stream
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_event_log_session_tool_event_sequence_stream
			ON event_log(session_id, tool_call_id, event_id, session_sequence ASC, stream_id ASC)
			WHERE tool_call_id IS NOT NULL
				AND type IN ('tool_execution_started', 'tool_execution_updated', 'tool_execution_finished')

rows.name: idx_event_log_session_tool_sequence_stream
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_event_log_session_tool_sequence_stream
			ON event_log(session_id, tool_call_id, session_sequence ASC, stream_id ASC)
			WHERE tool_call_id IS NOT NULL
				AND type IN ('tool_execution_started', 'tool_execution_updated', 'tool_execution_finished')

rows.name: idx_event_log_session_attribute_tool_event_sequence_stream
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_event_log_session_attribute_tool_event_sequence_stream
			ON event_log(
				session_id,
				json_extract(attributes_json, '$.toolCallId'),
				event_id,
				session_sequence ASC,
				stream_id ASC
			)
			WHERE type IN ('tool_execution_started', 'tool_execution_updated', 'tool_execution_finished')

queries.name: room_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM event_log WHERE room_id=?

plan.detail: SEARCH event_log USING COVERING INDEX idx_event_log_room_stream (room_id=?)

queries.name: accepted_recent
queries.sql: SELECT stream_id,session_id,actor_id,idempotency_key,created_at,json_extract(attributes_json,'$.clientTxnId') clientTxnId FROM event_log WHERE session_id=? AND type='user.message.accepted' ORDER BY session_sequence DESC LIMIT 5

plan.detail: SEARCH event_log USING INDEX idx_event_log_session_type_sequence_stream (session_id=? AND type=?)

queries.name: key_present
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM event_log WHERE idempotency_key=? LIMIT 1

queries.name: key_missing
queries.sql: SELECT stream_id FROM event_log WHERE idempotency_key=? LIMIT 1

plan.detail: SEARCH event_log USING COVERING INDEX idx_event_log_idempotency (idempotency_key=?)

queries.name: json_missing
queries.sql: SELECT stream_id FROM event_log WHERE room_id=? AND actor_id=? AND json_extract(attributes_json,'$.clientTxnId')=? ORDER BY stream_id ASC LIMIT 1

queries.name: json_present
queries.sql: SELECT stream_id FROM event_log WHERE room_id=? AND actor_id=? AND json_extract(attributes_json,'$.clientTxnId')=? ORDER BY stream_id ASC LIMIT 1

queries.name: accepted_coverage
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n,SUM(idempotency_key IS NULL) null_keys,SUM(json_extract(attributes_json,'$.clientTxnId') IS NOT NULL) has_txn,SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(attributes_json,'$.clientTxnId') IS NOT NULL AND (idempotency_key IS NULL OR idempotency_key != 'chat:user.accepted:'||coalesce(room_id,'')||':'||coalesce(actor_id,'')||':'||json_extract(attributes_json,'$.clientTxnId')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) noncanonical_txn_keys FROM event_log WHERE room_id=? AND type='user.message.accepted'

queries.name: sequence_current
queries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(session_sequence),0)+1 AS next_sequence FROM event_log WHERE session_id=?

plan.detail: SEARCH event_log USING COVERING INDEX idx_event_log_session_sequence_stream (session_id=?)
